clues: This town sits near the centre of a huge country. It is about the same long way from two far cities in that vast land.
The land round it is dry desert, so its heat swings wide through the year. Hot summer days give way to cold winter nights in this dry place.
The Arrernte have lived in this desert for tens of thousands of years. They were here long, long before any town was built.
It spreads across the Todd River, a stream that is dry most of the time. The MacDonnell Ranges stand just to the south of town.
This town is the heart of the Red Centre, the dry land in the middle of its country. If you know that name, you know this place.
